8. A small banner "LV 3".
Keep it readable on a phone: the goal clearly at the top, the player clearly at the bottom, rich detail but not cluttered.

World style: Japanese management-sim pixel style. A side-view cross-section of a narrow office building filling the screen, city at night behind it.
